name: glassgrid-you
title: GlassGrid You
description: Control GlassGrid You playback, Multiview streams, Floating Mini-Player, Ghost Mode, bookmarks, transcripts, and streaming services directly from Raycast.
author: zacharyzell

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: Inspect the active GlassGrid You video, timeline, chapters, and quick playback actions.

commands.name: search-youtube
commands.title: Search YouTube
commands.description: Search YouTube in a new GlassGrid You tab.

commands.name: toggle-play-pause
commands.title: Toggle Play / Pause
commands.description: Toggle play or pause on the active GlassGrid You video.

commands.name: toggle-mini-player
commands.title: Toggle Floating Mini-Player
commands.description: Toggle the always-on-top Floating Mini-Player or Floating Multiview Grid.

commands.name: toggle-ghost-mode
commands.title: Toggle Ghost Mode
commands.description: Toggle click-through Ghost Mode on the Floating Mini-Player (hold Option to peek).

commands.name: sync-all-streams
commands.title: Sync All Multiview Streams
commands.description: Sync all active Multiview tiles to live edge or the primary stream.

commands.name: add-bookmark
commands.title: Bookmark Current Timestamp
commands.description: Save a timestamped bookmark for the active GlassGrid You video.

commands.name: get-transcript
commands.title: Get Video Transcript
commands.description: Extract and search on-demand captions from the active YouTube watch page.

commands.name: open-service
commands.title: Open Streaming Service
commands.description: Browse and launch any of the 18 built-in streaming services in a tab or Multiview.
